title: Extending partial sections over a specified simplicial contraction
statement: Use small simplicial sets, degreewise products and pullbacks, standard simplices and horns as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $L$ be a simplicial set with a vertex $b$, and suppose a simplicial map $c:L\times\Delta^1\to L$ satisfies $c(-,0)=\operatorname{const}_b$ and $c(-,1)=\mathrm{id}_L$. Let $i:C\hookrightarrow L$ be a degreewise injective simplicial map. Let $q:E\to L$ be a Kan fibration, meaning that it lifts every horn inclusion $\Lambda_j^m\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$, $m\geq1$, $0\leq j\leq m$, and put $K=\{b\}\times_LE$. Suppose every simplicial map $u:C\to K$ extends to a simplicial map $v:L\to K$ with $vi=u$. Then every simplicial map $a:C\to E$ with $qa=i$ extends to a simplicial map $s:L\to E$ with $qs=\mathrm{id}_L$ and $si=a$. No Kan assumption on $L$ or $E$, no weak-equivalence assumption, and no requirement that $c$ fix $b$ at intermediate times is imposed.
